_comment: Card format counts for tests/cards/format-counts.test.ts (CR audit Phase 2, guard 4). history: dated entries; the last one must equal the code. A count may only shrink; an entry that raises one needs a reason saying why the format had to grow. knownPrimitiveKinds = KNOWN_PRIMITIVE_KINDS size; oneCardKinds = kinds exactly one card's JSON uses; cardDefFlags = optional boolean and number CardDef fields (tests/baselines/card-flags.json counts.cardDefFlags).

history.reason: CR audit area 1: host_self_as_condition replaces three engine-built host-as-condition continuations.

PF-S3a: Retrieval Run's optional breach replacement needs its own may_ kind (the old runEvent field always skipped the breach, CR 1.2.1), and a once-per-run ability used only when its optional part is carried out needs mark_ability_used_this_run (Snitch, CR 9.6.9d); no existing kind does either.

PF-S3b: Executive Wiretaps reveals HQ without gaining credits, so it needs a plain reveal_hq (Expert Schedule Analyzer builds it too); The Future Perfect's 'cannot steal this agenda during this access' needs forbid_steal_accessed_agenda (Pinhole Threading's lock lasts the run and also forbids the trash). runner_lose_credits_equal_corp_bad_publicity is gone (Ireress gains one subroutine per bad publicity through the per_bad_publicity declaration). One-card kinds also move because cards changed kind: may_install_from_heap and reveal_hq_gain_credits are left with one card each (Clone Chip and Executive Wiretaps moved off them), while Susanoo-no-Mikoto and Strongbox give forbid_jack_out_until_next_encounter and spend_click_additional_cost a second card. The five renamed may_ and verb-first kinds keep their counts.

PF-S3c: Architect installs without rezzing (CR 8.5.2), which its kind's install-and-rez does not allow, so it gets look_top_n_rd_may_install_ignore_install_cost; Eliza's Toybox rezzes any card, not only ice, so it gets rez_card_ignoring_costs (both one-card kinds). Three card fields are new, each a printed rule no field said: Domestic Sleepers is worth a flat point while it has an agenda counter (agendaPointsWhileHasAgendaCounter; Market Research keeps its per-counter field), The Board lowers every agenda in the Runner's score area while it is active (runnerScoredAgendaPointsModifier; Global Food Initiative keeps its own-card field), and I've Had Worse's trigger is met only by net or meat damage (trashFromGripTriggerOnlyByNetOrMeatDamage; Steelskin Scarring and Strike Fund keep the any-trash trigger). Medical Breakthrough's field is renamed (advancementRequirementReductionPerScoredCopy). Known kinds shrink: the three trace_*_success kinds, prevent_llds_trash_hardware, prevent_pending_when_encountered, add_hw_to_grip and Independent Thinking's two follow-ups are gone, and one engine follow-up, resolve_if_trace_strength_at_least, is new.

PF-S3d: Advanced Assembly Lines prints a mandatory install from HQ, and may_install_from_hq_paying_costs offers a Decline, so it gets install_from_hq_paying_costs (a one-card kind for now; Bioroid Work Crew and Red Level Clearance print the same mandatory install and can use it when area 5 takes them). Jesminder Sareen's field is renamed (preventFirstTagEachRun). Known kinds: take_copies and resolve_mumbad_city_hall_alliance are gone (Localized Product Line and Mumbad City Hall search through chooseCards), and one engine follow-up, resolve_ice_subroutine, is new: a subroutine resolved by Ravana 1.0, Orion, Wormhole, Upayoga or Mycoweb now resolves as its own ice's (net 1526, as before).
